description: Macron's 2017 programme targeted unemployment of 7% by 2022, not 5%.
evidence: Contemporaneous March 2017 reporting identifies a 7% target.

review.note: 2017 target was 7%, not 5%; full employment belongs to the later term. May 7 is election day, not a sourced announcement. Reassess status against actual target and INSEE, not the false 5% threshold.

promise: TerraUSD (UST) would always trade at $1, supported by billions of dollars in bitcoin reserves
description: Kwon promoted UST as a stablecoin that would hold its dollar peg, backed in part by a bitcoin reserve that the Luna Foundation Guard built up to about $3.5 billion. When UST depegged in May 2022, the foundation sold roughly 52,000 bitcoins trying to defend the peg; UST fell to about 9 cents and the Terra ecosystem collapsed. Kwon was later held liable for fraud by US regulators.
evidence: UST fell to ~$0.09 in May 2022 after weeks of trading below $1
Luna Foundation Guard moved 52,189 BTC to counterparties during the collapse

review.note: May 2022 reserve spending and loss of the peg are supported. The alleged March 20 unconditional guarantee and an expiry of May 31 are not established; a perpetual peg is not a promise due on an arbitrary month end. Specific 52,000-BTC figure also needs a matched transaction/accounting source.

sources.name: Reuters via The National: UST reserve losses
